title: Unit 5 : Inter-Ethnic Relations, Identity & Multiculturalism
content:
ሰላም! ሰላም! EthioFresh Family! ✋✨
እንኳን ወደ ማህበራዊ አንትሮፖሎጂ (Social Anthropology) ትምህርታችን በሰላም መጣችሁ! ዛሬ የUnit 5 (Part 1)ን ጥልቅና አጠቃላይ ፅንሰ-ሀሳብ ይዘንላችሁ ቀርበናል:: ፈገግ እያላችሁ፣ ዘና ብላችሁ ተከታተሉን:: 😊💡


1. UNIT FIVE OVERVIEW: INTER-ETHNIC RELATIONS, IDENTITY AND MULTICULTURALISM

This unit addresses ethnicity, ethnic identity, inter-ethnic relations, and multiculturalism at theoretical and empirical levels, drawing examples from Ethiopia and Africa. Identity politics and ethnic-based conflicts represent major 21st-century challenges affecting human and state relations. Ethnic identity shapes moral and political behaviors, daily actions, and self-belief. It carries political, sociological, and economic importance, influencing coexistence in multicultural settings. The unit explores how societies construct identities for nation-building, economic development, political mobilization, and resource control.

👉 ይህ ክፍል ስለ ብሔረሰብ (Ethnicity)፣ የብሔር ማንነት (Ethnic Identity)፣ የብሔረሰቦች ግንኙነት (Inter-ethnic relations) እና ብዙ-ባህላዊነት (Multiculturalism) በንድፈ-ሀሳብ እና በተግባራዊ ደረጃ ያብራራል:: በ21ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን በብሔር፣ በዘር እና በሃይማኖት ላይ የተመሰረቱ ግጭቶች የዓለማችን ትልቅ ፈተናዎች ሆነዋል:: የብሔር ማንነታችን የዕለት ተዕለት ባህሪያችንን፣ ሞራላችንን እና ፖለቲካዊ አመለካከታችንን ይቀርፃል:: ህብረተሰቦች ማንነትን እንዴት ለሀገር ግንባታ (Nation-building)፣ ለፖለቲካ ንቅናቄ (Political mobilization) እና ለኢኮኖሚ ሀብት ቁጥጥር እንደሚጠቀሙበት በጥልቀት እንመረምራለን::

💡 Exam Hint: ፈተና ላይ 'Identity Politics affects which aspects of society?' ተብሎ ከተጠየቀ 👉 Political, Sociological, and Economic aspects ብላችሁ መመለስ አለባችሁ!


2. ETHNIC GROUPS AND ETHNIC IDENTITY (SECTION 5.1)

A. Conceptualizing 'Ethnic Group'

The concept of 'ethnic group' is fundamental to understanding identity. Various scholars define it differently:
• Max Weber (1978): Defined an ethnic group as an entity formed based on a subjective belief in common descent, extending beyond kinship and political solidarity, represented by common customs, language, religion, values, morality, and etiquette.
• B. Anderson (1983): Described ethnic groups as an 'imagined community' possessing a specific character and quality.
• Schermerhorn (1996): Conceptualized an ethnic group as a population unit with unique characteristics relative to others, united by language, myth of origin, and history of ethnic allegiance.
• F. Barth (1969): Defined ethnic groups as self-identified groups based on subjective factors or fundamental cultural values chosen from past or present conditions. Group distinctiveness depends on self-identification and ascription by others.
• Abbink (2004): Stated that ethnic groups result from group interaction where members maintain social solidarity and identify as belonging to a group based on subjective communalities.

👉 የ'Ethnic Group' (የብሔር ስብስብ) ፅንሰ-ሀሳብ በልዩ ልዩ ምሁራን በተለያዩ መንገዶች ተበይኗል:
• Max Weber: ሰዎች የጋራ ትውልድ/ዘር አለን ብለው በሚያምኑበት እምነት (Subjective belief) ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው ይላል:: የደም ትስስር ባይኖር እንኳ በቋንቋ፣ በባህል፣ በሃይማኖት እና በእሴት ይስባሰባሉ::
• B. Anderson: 'Imagined Community' (በአእምሮ የታሰበ ማህበረሰብ) ብሎታል:: ምክንያቱም የአንድ ብሔር አባላት በሙሉ እርስ በእርስ በአካል ባይተዋወቁም የአንድ ማህበረሰብ አባል እንደሆኑ ያስባሉ::
• Schermerhorn: በቋንቋ፣ በጅማሬ አፈ-ታሪክ (Myth of origin) እና በታሪክ አንድ የሆኑ የህዝብ ክፍሎች ናቸው ይላል::
• Frederik Barth: የብሔር ስብስብ የሚፈጠረው በውስጥ አባላት ማንነትን በመቀበል (Self-identification) እና በውጭ ሰዎች በማንነት መፈረጅ (Ascription by others) ነው ይላል::

😂 አለፍ አለፍ ያለ ቀልድ: እንደ ዌበር አባባል ከሆንክ፣ ከማታውቀው ሰው ጋር የሩቅ ዘመድ ነን ብለህ ካመንክ አልቀረልህም... የብሔሩ አባል ነህ ማለት ነው! 😄

B. Six Main Features of an Ethnic Group (Hutchinson & Smith, 1996)

Hutchinson and Smith identified six core features that define an ethnic group:
1. A common proper name: Used to identify and express the 'essence' of the community.
2. A myth of common ancestry: Includes the idea of common origin in time and place, giving a sense of fictive kinship.
3. Shared historical memories: Common past including heroes, events, and commemorations.
4. One or more elements of common culture: Language, religion, or customs.
5. A link with a homeland: Symbolic attachment to an ancestral land (even if not physically occupied, as in a diaspora).
6. A sense of solidarity: Internal unity felt across sections of the population.

👉 Hutchinson እና Smith የብሔር ስብስብን የሚለዩ 6 ዋና ዋና ባህሪያትን ያስቀምጣሉ:
1. የጋራ መጠሪያ ስም (Common proper name): የማህበረሰቡን ማንነት የሚገልጽ::
2. የጋራ ዘር አፈ-ታሪክ (Myth of common ancestry): እውነተኛ ወይም ምናባዊ የጋራ መነሻ/ትውልድ ማመን::
3. የጋራ ታሪካዊ ትዝታዎች (Shared historical memories): የጋራ ጀግኖች፣ ክስተቶች እና መታሰቢያዎች::
4. የጋራ ባህል (Common culture): ቋንቋ፣ ሃይማኖት ወይም ልማዶች::
5. ከመነሻ ምድር ጋር ያለው ቁርኝት (Link with a homeland): ከትውልድ ቦታ ጋር ያለው መንፈሳዊ/ምልክታዊ ትስስር (በስደት/Diaspora ያሉትን ጨምሮ)::
6. የአንድነት ስሜት (Sense of solidarity): በአባላቱ መካከል ያለው ወንድማማችነትና ደጋፊነት::

💡 Exam Hint: የትኞቹ ናቸው 6ቱ የ Hutchinson & Smith መስፈርቶች? ብሎ በ'Matching' ወይም 'Multiple Choice' ፈተና ላይ ሊመጣ ስለሚችል በደንብ ያዟቸው!

C. Defining Ethnic Identity

Ethnic identity is an affiliate construct where individuals view themselves and are viewed by others as belonging to a specific group. It is influenced by:
• Racial factors: Physiognomic and physical characteristics.
• Natal factors: Ancestral homeland or origins of parents.
• Symbolic factors: Holidays, foods, clothing, and artifacts.

At the individual level, ethnicity is a social-psychological process providing a sense of belonging. At the broader level, it is a social phenomenon expressed externally through behavioral patterns. Ethnic identity consists of:
1. Objective aspects: Observable cultural and social behaviors (language, traditions, personal networks, institutions).
2. Subjective aspects: Internal images, attitudes, and feelings categorized into Cognitive, Moral, and Affective domains.

👉 የብሔር ማንነት (Ethnic Identity) ግለሰቦች ራሳቸውን የሚገልፁበትና በሌሎችም የሚገለፁበት መንገድ ነው:: በሶስት ነገሮች ይጎላበታል: Racial (አካላዊ ገጽታ)፣ Natal (የትውልድ ቦታ/የወላጆች አመጣጥ) እና Symbolic (በዓላት፣ ምግብ፣ አልባሳት)::

የብሔር ማንነት ሁለት አቅጣጫዎች አሉት:
1. Objective aspects (ግልጽ/ሚታዩ): የሚነገር ቋንቋ፣ ባህላዊ ልማዶች እና የህብረተሰብ ተቋማት::
2. Subjective aspects (የውስጥ ስሜት/አስተሳሰብ): በሶስት ይከፈላል: Cognitive (እውቀት)፣ Moral (ስነ-ምግባር) እና Affective (ስሜት/ፍቅር)::


3. ETHNICITY: IDENTIFICATION AND SOCIAL CATEGORIZATION (SECTION 5.2)

A. Concept of Identification

According to Brubaker (2004), identity is not a static 'thing' people possess; rather, people engage in 'identification'. Identity depends on social processes of identification rather than mechanistic causality (Jenkins, 2008). Ethnicity emerges through social life and daily interactions where people cope with life challenges.

B. Historical Background and Evolution of the Term 'Ethnicity'

• After World War II, terms like 'ethnicity', 'ethnic group', and 'nationalism' expanded rapidly in academic and public discourse.
• Early 20th-century theorists mistakenly predicted that ethnicity would diminish due to modernization, industrialization, and individualism. Instead, ethnicity gained political prominence post-WWII.
• The term 'ethnicity' replaced 'class structure' and 'class conflicts' as central topics in social sciences (Eriksen, 2002). The term first appeared in the Oxford English Dictionary in 1953 (Hutchinson & Smith, 1996).
• Etymology: Derived from Greek 'ethnos' (via Latin 'ethnikos'), meaning a group bound together by shared manners/customs. Ancient Greeks used 'ethnos' to refer to non-Greeks (heathens/barbarians). In early England, it referred to non-Christians and non-Jews.
• Shift in Usage: After WWII, 'ethnic' replaced 'tribe' (used for pre-modern societies) and 'race' (compromised due to Nazi ideology). In North America, 'ethnic' meant minority groups; in Europe, it was synonymous with 'nationhood'. Modern migration and political changes (e.g., Balkanization) further shifted ethnicity into a quasi-legislative domain concerning non-citizens and refugees.

👉 • በ20ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን መጀመሪያ ላይ ሶሺዮሎጂስቶች ዘመናዊነት (Modernization) እና ኢንዱስትሪ መስፋፋት የብሔር ማንነትን ያጠፋዋል ብለው አስበው ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት በኋላ የብሔር ጉዳይ ይበልጥ ጎልቶ ወጣ!
• 'Ethnicity' የሚለው ቃል ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በ Oxford English Dictionary የታተመው በ1953 ዓ.ም ነው::
• የቃሉ አመጣጥ (Etymology): ከግሪክ ቃል 'ethnos' (ከላቲኑ 'ethnikos') የመጣ ሲሆን ትርጉሙም 'በጋራ ልማድ የተሰባሰቡ ሰዎች' ማለት ነው:: በጥንታዊ ግሪኮች ዘንድ ግን 'ethnos' ማለት 'ግሪክ ያልሆኑ/የውጭ ሰዎች' ማለት ነበር::
• ከ2ኛው የዓለም ጦርነት በኋላ 'Tribe' እና 'Race' የሚሉት ቃላት በናዚ ርዕዮተ-ዓለም ምክንያት ተቀባይነት በማጣታቸው በ'Ethnic group' ተተክተዋል::

💡 Exam Hint: 'Ethnicity' የሚለው ቃል መቼ Dictionary ውስጥ ገባ? ➡️ 1953 (Oxford English Dictionary)! በጥንት ግሪክ ትርጉሙ ምን ነበር? ➡️ Non-Hellenic / Foreigners!


4. CONCEPTUALIZING ETHNICITY (SECTION 5.3)

A. Max Weber’s Sociological Perspective

Max Weber was among the few founding sociologists to analyze ethnicity in Economy and Society (1922). Key points from Weber include:
• Ethnic groups rest on a belief in common descent (whether objective blood relationships exist or not).
• Ethnic membership does not constitute a group by itself; it facilitates group formation, especially in the political sphere.
• Any shared cultural trait (language, economic lifestyle, rituals) can serve as a basis for ethnic closure.
• Ethnic groups are a specific form of status group with a shared sense of 'honor and dignity'.

👉 Max Weber በ1922 በጻፈው መጽሐፉ እንደገለጸው የብሔር ስብስብ መሠረቱ የጋራ ደም አለን ብሎ ማመን (Believed common descent) እንጂ የግድ እውነተኛ የደም ትስስር መኖር የለበትም:: የብሔር አባል መሆን በራሱ ቡድን አይፈጥርም፤ ነገር ግን ለፖለቲካዊ ስብስብ በር ይከፍታል::

B. Frederik Barth’s Anthropological Model (1969)

Frederik Barth revolutionized ethnic studies in Ethnic Groups and Boundaries (1969):
• Ascription and Self-ascription: Categorical ascription is how individuals classify themselves and others into ethnic categories.
• Focus on Boundaries, Not 'Cultural Stuff': Barth argued that ethnicity is not defined by internal cultural traits (language, food) but by social boundaries maintained through interaction with 'others'.
• Cultural features of ethnic dichotomies fall into:
1. Overt signals/signs: Visible features like dress, language, house styles.
2. Basic value orientations: Moral standards of performance.
• Social Interaction: Culture is generated through interaction. Groups define themselves in relation to what they are NOT (e.g., in Ethiopia, Oromoness is defined in relation to interaction with Amharaness, Gurageness, Somaliness, etc.).

👉 Frederik Barth በ1969 ያቀረበው ሀሳብ የአንትሮፖሎጂን እይታ ቀይሯል:
• ባርት እንደሚለው የብሔር ማንነት የሚወሰነው በውስጡ ባለው ባህል (Cultural stuff - እንደ ምግብ፣ ዳንስ) ሳይሆን በድንበር/ወሰን (Ethnic Boundary) እና ከሌሎች ጋር በሚደረግ ግንኙነት (Social interaction) ነው::
• የብሔር ድንበር የሚባለው የፖለቲካ ወይም የካርታ ድንበር ሳይሆን 'እኛ' (Us) እና 'እነሱ' (Them) የሚለውን ልዩነት የሚፈጥር ማህበራዊ ድንበር ነው:: ለምሳሌ የኦሮሞነት፣ የአማራነት፣ የጉራጌነት ወይም የሱማሌነት ማንነት የሚጎላው እርስ በእርስ በሚደረግ ግንኙነትና ልዩነት ነው::

💡 Exam Hint: 'The critical focus of investigation is the ethnic boundary that defines the group, not the cultural stuff it encloses' — ይህንን ያላችሁ ምሁር ማነው? 👉 Frederik Barth (1969)!

C. Basic Social Anthropological Model Summary

• Ethnicity is a matter of cultural differentiation involving a dialectical interplay between similarity and difference.
• Ethnicity is a matter of shared meanings produced and reproduced during interaction.
• Ethnicity is both collective and individual, externalized in social interaction and internalized in personal self-identification.

👉 በአንትሮፖሎጂ አጠቃላይ መደምደሚያ: ብሔረሰብነት ማለት በግንኙነት ውስጥ የሚፈጠር የልዩነት እና የአንድነት ውህደት ነው:: በውስጣችን የምንቀበለው (Internalized) እና በውጭ ከሰዎች ጋር ስንገናኝ የምናሳየው (Externalized) ማንነት ነው::
